DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 休憩所で使える卓上ゲームがあります。遊ばれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: We have tabletop games you can use in the rest area. Would you like to play?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人で遊びたいです。初めてなので、短い時間で覚えられる物を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人で短時間に覚えられる卓上ゲームを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are two of us who would like to play. It is our first time, so please suggest something we can learn quickly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a tabletop game two people can learn in a short time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この円盤を使うゲームはいかがですか。白と黒の駒を並べて始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: How about this game using discs? You start by arranging the white and black pieces.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それを借ります。持ってきた飲み物を脇へ置いて、この机で遊んでよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ゲームを借り休憩机の利用を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: We will borrow that one. May we put the drinks we brought to the side and play at this table?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Borrow the game and ask to use the table in the rest area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。盤は机の中央へ置いてください。最初の四枚の配置はこの図です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Please put the board in the middle of the table. This diagram shows the starting positions of the first four pieces.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 白と黒を二枚ずつ、図のように置きました。次はどこへ置けるのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 初期配置の白黒二枚ずつを置き次の置き場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: We have placed two white and two black pieces as shown. Where can we put the next piece?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Place two white and two black pieces in their starting positions and ask where to play next. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相手の色を挟める所へ置きます。この一手を見本でお見せしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Place it where you can trap pieces of the other color between yours. Let me demonstrate this move.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 挟んだ駒を裏返すのですね。友人と交代で一手ずつ試します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 挟んだ駒の反転を理解し交代で試す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: So we turn over the pieces we have trapped. My friend and I will take turns trying one move each.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show you understand turning over the trapped pieces and try taking turns. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 駒が置けない時のルールも、この紙にあります。片付ける時は箱の数を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The rules for when you cannot place a piece are also on this sheet. When putting things away, please check the number of boxes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。紙を横へ置いて遊び、終わったら駒を箱へ戻して案内所へ返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明紙を使い終了後に駒をそろえて返すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. We will keep the sheet beside us while playing, then put the pieces back in the box and return it to the information desk when finished.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will use the instruction sheet, then gather all the pieces and return the game afterward. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 盤と駒をどうぞ。それでは、お二人でゲームをお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27216-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are the board and pieces. Enjoy the game together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 駅の設備についてご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the station facilities?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: トイレを使いたいのですが、改札の中にあるのですね。電車には乗らず、トイレだけ利用できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 列車に乗らず改札内トイレだけ利用可能か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to use the toilet, but it is inside the ticket gates. Can I use just the toilet without taking a train?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can use the toilet inside the ticket gates without taking a train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 改札内へ入る場合は入場券が必要です。駅の外のトイレでしたら、前の公共施設にもあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You need an admission ticket to enter the gated area. For a toilet outside the station, there is also one in the public facility in front.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前の施設は今日は閉まっていました。入場券の料金を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 外施設の閉館を伝え入場券料金を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The facility in front was closed today. Please tell me the price of an admission ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Mention that the facility outside is closed and ask the admission ticket price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 料金はこちらです。入場券では列車に乗れません。ご利用の時間にも、この券の条件があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here is the price. An admission ticket does not allow you to ride a train. This ticket also has conditions concerning how long you may use it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 条件を読みます。トイレを使ったら、この改札から出る予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 券の条件を読み同じ改札から退出すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will read the conditions. After using the toilet, I plan to leave through this ticket gate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will read the ticket conditions and leave through the same gate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、こちらの券売機で入場券をお求めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then please buy an admission ticket at this ticket machine.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入場券のボタンを押しました。行先の切符を選ぶのではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 券売機で行先券ではなく入場券を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I pressed the admission-ticket button. So I do not choose a ticket for a destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose an admission ticket at the machine rather than a ticket to a destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。購入した券は、出るときまでお持ちください。トイレは改札の先の右側です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Correct. Keep the ticket you buy until you leave. The toilet is on the right beyond the gate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 券を受け取りました。右側のトイレへ行き、券を持ってここから出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 券を保持して右のトイレ利用後に戻ると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have received the ticket. I will go to the toilet on the right and leave through here with the ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you will keep the ticket and return after using the toilet on the right. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞご利用ください。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go ahead and use it. I will leave you to it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 手続きの案内をご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to see the information about the procedure?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ベトナム語の案内を持ち帰りたいです。この小さい文字だと、母が読むのが難しそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 母のため母語案内の文字拡大を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to take the Vietnamese information home. With the print this small, it looks difficult for my mother to read.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to enlarge the print in the native-language information for your mother. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 原稿を拡大して印刷できるか確認します。何の手続きの案内でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check whether we can enlarge the original and print it. Which procedure is the information about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 住所の変更です。このページの必要な持ち物の所を、大きくしてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 住所変更の持物欄を示し大きくしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Changing an address. Could you enlarge the section on this page about what to bring?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point to the items-to-bring section for an address change and ask to enlarge it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一ページを二枚に分けると、大きくできます。前後の説明も合わせて印刷しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can enlarge it by splitting one page across two sheets. Shall we print the explanations before and after it as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 合わせてお願いします。持ち物の所だけだと、どの手続きの話か分からなくなるので、見出しも欲しいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 前後説明と見出しを含む印刷を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please include those too. With only the items-to-bring section, we would not know which procedure it is about, so I would like the heading as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a printout including the surrounding explanations and the heading. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見出しと、その続きが分かるようページ番号を付けました。この大きさはどうでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I have added page numbers so the heading and its continuation are clear. How is this size?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 読めそうです。二枚を続きの順に留めてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 拡大サイズを確認し続き順の綴じを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: It looks readable. Could you fasten the two sheets together in the correct order?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the enlarged size and ask to fasten the sheets in sequence. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。元の小さい案内も、一緒にお渡しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We can also give you the original small-print information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 元の案内もください。母には大きい方を渡し、私はこちらの元の版を手元に置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 母用拡大版と自分用原版を受け取る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please give me the original too. I will give my mother the large version and keep this original version with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Receive the enlarged version for your mother and the original for yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二つの版をどうぞ。ご相談ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are both versions. Thank you for consulting us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 呼び出しについて、お困りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the call system?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 画面に私と同じ名字が出ましたが、番号が違います。立って行くべきか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同姓表示だが番号不一致で動くか迷うと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The screen showed the same surname as mine, but the number is different. I am unsure whether I should get up and go over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help because the displayed surname matches yours but the number does not, and you are unsure whether to move. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お手元の受付票を見せてください。受付番号でご案内しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me your reception slip. We call people by their reception number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私の票は三十八番です。画面は三十六番でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分三十八番と表示三十六番を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: My slip is number thirty-eight. The screen showed thirty-six.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give your own number, thirty-eight, and the displayed number, thirty-six. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の表示は別の方です。三十八番が出るまでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The current display is for someone else. Please wait until thirty-eight appears.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。名字だけで動かず番号を見ます。この席だと画面の右端が柱で隠れています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 番号で待つと理解し柱で画面が見えないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will watch the number rather than moving based on the surname alone. From this seat, a pillar hides the right edge of the screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show you understand waiting by number and explain that a pillar blocks the screen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの席なら番号まで見えます。移動されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can see the number from this seat. Would you like to move?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 移動します。そこなら、かばんを足元へ置いても通路に出ませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 画面が見え通路をふさがない席へ移ると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will move. There, even if I put my bag at my feet, it will not stick out into the aisle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will move to a seat where you can see the screen without blocking the aisle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。受付票も、番号が見えるよう手元へ置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please also keep your reception slip at hand with the number visible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 席を移りました。三十八番の票と画面を見比べて待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 移動後に受付票と画面を照合して待つと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have moved seats. I will wait while comparing my number-thirty-eight slip with the screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you will compare the reception slip with the screen and wait after moving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、順番までお待ちください。ご相談ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please wait for your turn. Thank you for consulting us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 撮影の計画について、ご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss your filming plans?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 商店街の紹介動画を撮ります。歩道に三脚と照明を置く予定なので、道路を使う手続きが必要か聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 歩道の三脚と照明に道路使用手続きが必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: We will film a video introducing the shopping street. We plan to place tripods and a light on the sidewalk, so I would like to ask whether road-use procedures are required.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether placing tripods and a light on the sidewalk requires road-use procedures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 道路の使用について交通担当が確認します。撮影する場所を図で示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: The traffic department will check about using the road. Can you show the filming location on a diagram?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この店の前です。三脚二台と照明一台を、この歩道の端へ置きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 店前の図と三脚二台と照明一台の位置を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: In front of this shop. We would like to place two tripods and one light at this edge of the sidewalk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the diagram in front of the shop and the positions of two tripods and one light. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 機材の位置だけでなく、人が通れる幅も分かる資料をお願いします。撮影予定日はいつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please prepare material showing not only the equipment positions but also the width available for pedestrians. When do you plan to film?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 来月の土曜午前です。まだ幅を測っていないので、現地で測って図に書き足します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 撮影日を伝え未測定の通行幅を測って足すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: On a Saturday morning next month. We have not measured the width yet, so we will measure it on site and add it to the diagram.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the filming date and say you will measure the unmeasured passage width and add it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その資料で担当へご相談ください。通行を止めたり、車道へ人を誘導したりする予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please consult the department with that material. Do you plan to stop people passing through or direct them into the roadway?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありません。歩道を空けられないなら、店内から撮る案へ変えます。店の了承は受けています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 交通停止予定なしで通行不可なら店内撮影へ変更すると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. If we cannot leave the sidewalk clear, we will change to filming from inside the shop. We have the shop's consent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you do not plan to stop passage and will film inside the shop if passage cannot be maintained. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 店の了承と道路の扱いは、それぞれ確認します。担当への相談用の案内はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The shop's consent and the handling of the road will be checked separately. Here is information for consulting the department.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内を持ち帰ります。日時、機材の位置、通行幅をそろえてから交通担当へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日時と機材配置と幅をそろえ交通担当へ相談すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the information home. Once we have the date and time, equipment positions, and passage width ready, we will consult the traffic department.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you will prepare the date and time, equipment layout, and width before consulting the traffic department. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 交通担当の相談先も記載しています。それでは、ご準備のうえお越しください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: The traffic department's contact details are also listed. Please prepare those details before coming. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのはがきについてご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to ask about this postcard?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分で写真を印刷しました。裏は全面写真で、表にも文字があります。宛名を書く場所が足りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真全面と印刷文字で宛名スペースが少ないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I printed the photograph myself. The back is entirely a photo, and there is text on the front too. There is not enough room to write the address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the full-side photo and printed text leave little room for the address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宛名と切手を貼る面を拝見します。印刷の文字は、この下側にありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me see the side for the address and stamp. The printed text is down here, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。上に宛名を書くと、郵便番号の枠から住所がはみ出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号枠と長い住所の収まりを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. If I write the address above, it extends beyond the postal-code boxes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain how the postal-code boxes and the long address fit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 郵便番号は枠に、住所と宛名はこの空いた部分へ読みやすく書けます。印刷した文字を隠さず収まりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can write the postal code in the boxes and the address and recipient's name legibly in this blank area. Will it fit without covering the printed text?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 短く詰めるより、ここに縦で書けば収まりそうです。差出人の住所はどこに書けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 空白へ縦書きを選び差出人欄を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: It looks like it will fit if I write vertically here, rather than squeezing it together. Where can I write the sender's address?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose vertical writing in the blank space and ask about the sender's section. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この左側へ、小さ過ぎない字でお願いします。配達先の宛名より控えめな位置です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here on the left, please, in writing that is not too small. Use a less prominent position than the recipient's address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 左側に差出人を書きます。切手の場所は、この右上を空ければよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 差出人位置と切手用右上の空白を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will write the sender on the left. For the stamp, should I leave this upper-right area blank?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the sender's position and the upper-right blank area for the stamp. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。料金は重さと形も確認しますので、書けましたらお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We will also check the weight and shape to determine the postage, so please bring it when you have written it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 配置を鉛筆で薄く決めました。家で清書して、写真を折らないよう持って来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 配置を下書きし家で清書後に持参すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have lightly planned the layout in pencil. I will write the final version at home and bring it without bending the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have drafted the layout and will bring it after writing the final version at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お待ちしております。それでは、はがき作りをお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We look forward to seeing you. Enjoy making your postcard.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住宅ローンについてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss your housing loan, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まとまったお金ができたので、一部を先に返す方法を知りたいです。月々の額を減らす方を考えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住宅ローンの部分繰上返済で月額減少を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have saved a lump sum, so I would like to know how to repay part of it early. I am considering reducing the monthly amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Express a wish to reduce monthly payments through partial early repayment of your housing loan. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 期間を短くする方法と、月々の返済額を見直す方法について担当がご説明します。返したい金額はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The staff member in charge will explain shortening the term and revising the monthly repayment amount. Do you have an amount you would like to repay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三十万円です。生活費とは別に用意しました。二つの方法で、どのくらい変わるか比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三十万円と二方法の比較試算を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Three hundred thousand yen. I set it aside separately from living expenses. I would like to compare how much each of the two methods changes things.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the amount of three hundred thousand yen and request comparative estimates for both methods. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 契約が分かる資料はお持ちですか。手数料や申込みの方法も担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have documents showing your contract? The staff member will also check fees and how to apply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この返済予定表があります。新しい月額だけでなく、手数料も含めた試算をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 契約予定表を示し手数料を含む試算を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have this repayment schedule. Please provide estimates including the fees, not just the new monthly amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your contractual repayment schedule and request estimates including fees. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へお伝えします。今日は返済の実行までご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will tell the staff member. Would you like to carry out the repayment today as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は試算を持ち帰りたいです。家で今後の支出も見てから、どちらにするか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日は実行せず試算を持帰り検討すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Today I would like to take the estimates home. After looking at future expenses at home too, I will decide which method to choose.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will take the estimates home to consider rather than carrying out repayment today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご希望で受け付けます。今の返済が引き落とされる日はお分かりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will accept your request on that basis. Do you know the date your current repayments are debited?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 毎月二十七日です。追加で返す日も、通常の返済とどう重なるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現引落日二十七日と追加返済日との関係を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: On the twenty-seventh of each month. I would also like to ask how the date of the additional repayment fits in with the regular repayment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the current debit date of the twenty-seventh and ask how it relates to the extra repayment date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、予定表をお持ちになって担当へどうぞ。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please take your schedule to the staff member in charge. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お肉は何名様分でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: How many people is the meat for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人ですが、一人はあまり食べません。人数分の盛合せより、欲しい重さで買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人の食欲差から人数分でなく重量で購入したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two, but one does not eat very much. Rather than an assortment based on the number of people, I would like to buy the weight we want.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the two people have different appetites and you want to buy by weight rather than by head count. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 量り売りでしたら、グラムでお選びいただけます。どの部位をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: For meat sold by weight, you can choose the number of grams. Which cut would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この薄切りを二百五十グラムお願いします。棚の表示は百グラムの値段ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 薄切り二百五十グラムと百グラム単価を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two hundred fifty grams of this thinly sliced meat, please. The shelf label gives the price per hundred grams, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm two hundred fifty grams of thin slices and the unit price per hundred grams. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。二百五十グラムなら、およその価格はこちらです。脂身の量のご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. For two hundred fifty grams, this is the approximate price. Do you have a preference for how much fat it has?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 脂が少なめの部分にしたいです。見本より少し赤身の多いものを選べますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 脂身が少ない肉を選べるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like a part with less fat. Can I choose one a little leaner than the sample?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can choose meat with less fat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの部位もございます。価格が違いますので、表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We also have this cut. The price is different, so please check the label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この赤身の多い方に変えます。二百五十グラムでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 価格を見て赤身部位へ変更し希望重量を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will switch to this leaner one. Two hundred fifty grams, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the price, switch to the leaner cut, and give your preferred weight. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二百五十五グラムになりました。この量と価格でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: It comes to two hundred fifty-five grams. Is this quantity and price all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その量で大丈夫です。一つの包みで持ち帰り、家で食べる量に合わせて分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 実測二百五十五グラムを承諾し一包みを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: That quantity is fine. I will take it home in one package and divide it at home according to how much we will eat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Accept the measured two hundred fifty-five grams and request one package. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お包みしました。それでは、お会計へどうぞ。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: It is wrapped. Please proceed to checkout. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 音を集める散歩の用紙をご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to look at the sheet for the sound-collecting walk?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 見たいです。鳥の声を録音する催しだと思いましたが、地図を持って歩くのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 録音催しか地図活動か内容を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I thought this was an event for recording birdsong; do we walk with a map?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the activity involves recording sounds or using a map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 録音ではなく、聞こえた音を場所ごとに地図へ描く活動です。入口で何か聞こえましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Rather than recording, the activity is to draw the sounds you hear on a map by location. Did you hear anything at the entrance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 水の流れる音が聞こえました。入口の池のそばに、水の印を付ければよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口池の水音を地図へ記す場所を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I heard flowing water. Should I put a water symbol near the pond at the entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm where to mark the sound of water by the entrance pond on the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。聞いた位置へ印を付けてください。音の名前が分からなければ、感じた言葉でも書けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Put the symbol where you heard it. If you do not know the name of a sound, you can write words describing how it felt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 木の上から短い高い声も聞きました。鳥の種類は分からないので、高い声と書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未識別鳥声を高い声と表現すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I also heard a short, high-pitched call from up in a tree. I do not know the bird species, so I will write 'high-pitched call.'
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will describe the unidentified bird call as a high-pitched call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの地図には、見た物と聞いた音を別の色で書けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: On this map, you can use different colors for things you saw and sounds you heard.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 見た木は緑、聞いた声は青にします。同じ場所に二つの印を付けました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見た木と聞いた声を別色で記す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will use green for the tree I saw and blue for the call I heard. I have put two symbols in the same place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Mark the tree you saw and the call you heard in different colors. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 一周した後は、感想の欄へ一言書いて案内所へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: After one circuit, write a short comment in the impressions section and bring the sheet to the information desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は水と高い声から始めます。地図を見過ぎず、ときどき立ち止まって聞いてから印を付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 安全に立ち止まりながら音を聞き地図へ記すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I will start with water and the high-pitched call. I will avoid looking at the map too much, stop from time to time to listen, and then add symbols.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to stop safely, listen to the sounds, and mark them on the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、用紙をどうぞ。音の散歩をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27217-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is your sheet. Enjoy your sound walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この列車は途中の駅で前と後ろが分かれます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: This train splits into front and rear portions at a station along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 山側の終点へ行きます。今は後ろの車両の前にいますが、どちらへ乗ればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 切離列車の山側終点へ向かう乗車位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am going to the mountain-side terminus. I am currently in front of the rear cars; which portion should I board?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to board the splitting train for the mountain-side terminus. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 山側へ進むのは前の四両です。後ろの四両は別の終点へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The front four cars go toward the mountains. The rear four cars go to a different terminus.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ列車なら最後まで一緒だと思っていました。前の四両へ、ホームから移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前四両へホーム上で移ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought the same train stayed together until the end. I will move along the platform to the front four cars.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will move along the platform to the front four cars. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 足元の乗車位置では、一号車から四号車です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The boarding positions marked at your feet are cars one through four.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今いる八号車から一号車側へ歩きます。四号車でも山側の終点へ行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 八号車位置から移り四号車の到達先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will walk from my current position at car eight toward car one. Can I reach the mountain-side terminus in car four too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Move from the car-eight position and ask where car four goes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 四号車で大丈夫です。各車両の行先表示もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Car four is fine. Please also check each car's destination display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 四号車の表示に山側の終点がありました。ここで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 四号車行先表示を確認し待機位置を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Car four's display shows the mountain-side terminus. I will wait here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check car four's destination display and decide where to wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 切離しの駅では、案内が終わるまで停車します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: At the station where the train splits, it will remain stopped until the announcements finish.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 停車しても降りる駅ではないので、案内を聞きながらこの車両に乗ったまま待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 切離し停車中も降車せず案内を聞くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Even when we stop, it is not my station to get off at, so I will stay in this car and wait while listening to the announcements.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will stay aboard during the stop for splitting and listen to the announcements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、四号車からご乗車ください。よいご旅行を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27218-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please board car four. Have a pleasant trip.
